user.title: Add Kramer AV device
user.description: Enter the address. Leave counts at 0 to discover a known VP device profile, SIGNALS-LIST? (X-ROUTE), or INFO-IO?. TCP typically uses port 5000 and UDP port 50000.

data_description.command_family: Auto tries X-ROUTE? with SIGNALS-LIST? discovery first, then ROUTE? and VID?.
data_description.profile_mode: Auto verifies exact VP models using a read-only ROUTE query; Generic disables VP profiles and uses manually configured counts and command family.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect or receive a Protocol 3000 model response
error.not_protocol_3000: The device did not identify itself using Protocol 3000

abort.already_configured: This address and protocol are already configured

init.title: Kramer AV options
init.description: Comma-separated friendly names in physical port order. Leave an item blank to retain its numeric label. Names are suffixes, e.g. 'Input 1 — PC'.
